summary: Frontend-only validation completed for Timeline V4 hybrid-design regression on public URL across desktop/mobile viewports. Core routing, controls, theme switching, no-overflow matrix, and exact timeline stop passed. Critical rapid-switch DOM uniqueness and reduced-motion scan behavior failed expected requirements.

ui_bugs.issue: Rapid switching seasons/tabs leaves multiple concurrent 'active' nodes in DOM (timeline-active-image x4, data cards x3, image echoes x4), violating single-active-article/image expectation and creating duplicate critical test IDs.
With prefers-reduced-motion enabled, scanning beam element still renders (scanCount=1). Requirement expects absent/effectively disabled scan animation under reduced motion.

integration_issues.flow: Rapid season and tab switching stress flow
integration_issues.issue: Duplicate critical data-testid values appear during transition overlap; violates uniqueness and indicates concurrent mounted transition states.

action_items: Ensure only one active timeline image/data/echo remains mounted after rapid interactions (avoid overlapping active test IDs during AnimatePresence transitions).
Enforce reduced-motion handling so scanning beam is not rendered or has animation effectively disabled when prefers-reduced-motion is true.
Add data-testid to newly introduced user-visible telemetry overlays (echo/dissolve/sector labels/scan signal) if considered critical interaction/verification surfaces.
critical_code_review_comments: Timeline exact direct route remains deterministic at progress 0.305 with data-traveling=false.
Desktop blend target appears met visually (no hard vertical seam; computed left border on data pane is 0px).
Theme switching correctly changes accent while championship rank color remains semantically separate from team accent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on public URL with viewport matrix 1920x800, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844, 320x700: no horizontal overflow. Route checks passed for circuit/legacy/cars/timeline and timeline boundary controls passed. Key failing area is rapid interaction transition overlap causing duplicate active DOM and duplicate critical test IDs.
rca of the issue: RCA: SeasonTimeline uses AnimatePresence mode='sync' for image/data/echo blocks keyed by year. Under fast sequential state updates, exiting and entering nodes coexist for transition duration, causing multiple simultaneously mounted 'active' elements and duplicate data-testid values. For reduced-motion issue, UI automation observed .timeline-v4-scan still present under reduced-motion emulation, indicating render gating and/or CSS animation disable path is not consistently preventing scan effect in RM mode.
